title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software



ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.


With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software

title: GenAI Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Software Engineer focused on Artificial Intelligence, you will make a significant contribution to the construction of innovative AI Agents by collaborating closely with your engineering peers. This role requires a high degree of creative thinking and a strong willingness to learn, as you will be working with the latest in Generative AI tools and frameworks. The Agentic AI Engineer explores emerging technologies, promotes new development approaches, and helps shape the standards for intelligent automation, playing a fundamental role in advancing the company's AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of autonomous AI Agents, leveraging LLMs, advanced techniques such as RAG, and agent-specific frameworks;
  • Develop full-stack applications that support and interact with AI Agents, using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Next.js to build the necessary interfaces and systems;
  • Explore and experiment with emerging technologies and frameworks in the agentic space, fostering innovation and shaping best practices;
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to define the behavior, capabilities, and goals of AI Agents, translating business requirements into robust agentic solutions;
  • Ensure code quality through rigorous reviews, testing, and documentation, while mentoring other engineers on development best practices.


Essential Skills

  • Solid experience in software engineering, with proven expertise in writing clean, maintainable code and leveraging modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure quality and automate delivery;
  • Hands-on and up-to-date knowledge of Generative AI, including experience building and implementing features with LLMs in real-world products;
  • Strong foundation in software engineering principles, including system design, API architecture, code quality, and testing.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience in designing GenAI solutions architecture, agent frameworks, and advanced techniques such as RAG;
  • Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to production-grade systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, including proficiency with modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI for the purpose of building, testing, and deploying autonomous, goal-oriented agents.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Data Architect, Analytics Services
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior/Especialista que atue com Data Architect, Analytics Services


Responsabilidades:


  • Ajudar clientes a aprender e utilizar serviços AWS como Athena, Glue, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, NoSQL, RDS, EMR e Redshift
  • Conduzir entregas técnicas com clientes, incluindo entendimento de requisitos e criação de ofertas de serviços de Dados & Analytics
  • Engajar stakeholders de negócio e tecnologia do cliente para criar uma visão convincente de uma empresa orientada a dados
  • Trabalhar com times de engenharia e suporte da AWS para comunicar necessidades e feedback de parceiros e clientes como insumo para roadmaps de tecnologia
  • Compartilhar implementações reais e recomendar novas capacidades que simplifiquem a adoção e gerem maior valor no uso dos serviços AWS
  • Engajar stakeholders do cliente para reforçar a visão de transformação orientada por dados em seu ambiente


Requisitos:


  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de formação e experiência prática
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em arquitetura e implementação em nuvem, preferencialmente com AWS
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência com bancos de dados (SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência entregando projetos ou soluções em nuvem
  • Experiência com tecnologias SQL-on-Hadoop (Hive, Impala, Spark SQL, Presto)
  • Experiência desenvolvendo código em uma ou mais linguagens de programação (Java, Python, etc.)


Desejável:


  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em gerenciamento de projetos complexos e de grande escala, com clientes internos ou externos
  • Proficiência em uma ampla gama de serviços AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation)
  • Experiência com automação e scripting (Terraform, Python)
  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Certified AI Practitioner
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
  • AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior/Especialista que atue com Data Architect, Analytics Services


Responsabilidades:


  • Ajudar clientes a aprender e utilizar serviços AWS como Athena, Glue, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, NoSQL, RDS, EMR e Redshift
  • Conduzir entregas técnicas com clientes, incluindo entendimento de requisitos e criação de ofertas de serviços de Dados & Analytics
  • Engajar stakeholders de negócio e tecnologia do cliente para criar uma visão convincente de uma empresa orientada a dados
  • Trabalhar com times de engenharia e suporte da AWS para comunicar necessidades e feedback de parceiros e clientes como insumo para roadmaps de tecnologia
  • Compartilhar implementações reais e recomendar novas capacidades que simplifiquem a adoção e gerem maior valor no uso dos serviços AWS
  • Engajar stakeholders do cliente para reforçar a visão de transformação orientada por dados em seu ambiente


Requisitos:


  • Bacharelado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada, ou combinação equivalente de formação e experiência prática
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em arquitetura e implementação em nuvem, preferencialmente com AWS
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência com bancos de dados (SQL, NoSQL, Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, Kinesis)
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência entregando projetos ou soluções em nuvem
  • Experiência com tecnologias SQL-on-Hadoop (Hive, Impala, Spark SQL, Presto)
  • Experiência desenvolvendo código em uma ou mais linguagens de programação (Java, Python, etc.)


Desejável:


  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em gerenciamento de projetos complexos e de grande escala, com clientes internos ou externos
  • Proficiência em uma ampla gama de serviços AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, VPC, CloudFormation)
  • Experiência com automação e scripting (Terraform, Python)
  • Certificações AWS, como:
  • AWS Certified AI Practitioner
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate
  • AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;

  • Gympass;

  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.

title: Analista de Customer Success
description:
Estamos em busca de talentos que queiram crescer junto com a transformação digital.


Se você é movido por desafios, quer se desenvolver profissionalmente em um ambiente dinâmico, tem paixão por criar relacionamentos e interesse genuíno em tecnologia e inovação, essa pode ser a sua próxima grande oportunidade.


Com a rápida evolução das soluções em nuvem e a transformação constante do mercado de tecnologia, o modelo de vendas mudou — e isso exige profissionais adaptáveis, curiosos e dispostos a aprender continuamente. Procuramos Analista de Customer Success com mentalidade de crescimento, que valorizem a construção de relacionamentos, saibam trabalhar em equipe e consigam tratar cada cliente de maneira única e especial.


Você fará parte de um time ágil, focado em resultados e altamente colaborativo.


Se você quer aprender, se desenvolver e crescer em uma empresa que acompanha as mudanças do mercado, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente.


Vale a pena conhecer a vaga!


Responsabilidades:


  • Ser resolutivo (a) com os eventuais conflitos em clientes;
  • Entender e conduzir de forma amigável os atendimentos;
  • Estabelecer ótimo relacionamento com os clientes;
  • Análise de números, elaboração de gráficos;
  • Responsável por entender o nível de sucesso dos clientes;
  • Apoio e suporte ao time de vendas.


Qualificações básicas:


  • Gostar de desafios;
  • Amar relacionamento com clientes;
  • Ser excelente ouvinte;
  • Ter bom controle emocional;
  • Experiência prévia como Assistente de Customer Success em empresas de software;
  • Totalmente comprometido com as metas e resultados;
  • Treinável e flexível às mudanças (durante o projeto, será provável a necessidade de novas técnicas, novos produtos, e novas abordagens);
  • Fortemente auto motivável;
  • Facilidade e gosto em conversas telefônicas – uma parte importante do trabalho será reuniões remotas com clientes;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de Customer Success;
  • Pensamento criativo;
  • Empatia (fundamental para esse trabalho);
  • Que seja proativo para trabalhar sozinho buscando seus próprios resultados independente de ajuda e necessidade de supervisão;
  • Saber trabalhar com ferramentas do Office: Word, Excel, Outlook e PowerPoint;
  • Habilidade em conhecer novos métodos de trabalho. Necessidade de entender e aplicar a forma de trabalho da empresa.


Qualificações preferidas não obrigatórias:


  • Nível superior
  • Boas noções Comerciais (Área de Vendas) e/ou Relacionamento com clientes (Customer Success)
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas colaborativas Microsoft.


Experiências prévias desejadas:


  • Atuação em área de Customer Success, mínimo 6 meses.

title: Projetista de Produto - NX Unigraphics
description:
A STEP é uma empresa de engenharia especializada no setor automotivo, reconhecida por sua excelência técnica e compromisso com a inovação. Fundada em 1992, a empresa estabeleceu sua sede em Turim, cidade considerada o centro do desenvolvimento automotivo na Itália.

Com o objetivo de expandir sua atuação e atender melhor às demandas regionais, a STEP inaugurou em 2004 a unidade Step do Sul , localizada em Pomigliano, na província de Nápoles.

Em 2009, dando continuidade ao seu plano de internacionalização, a empresa investiu na América Latina, o que resultou na abertura de uma Sede também em Contagem (Minas Gerais, Brasil) , ampliando sua presença no mercado global.


Sobre a vaga:

Buscamos projetistas Pleno e Sênior para desenvolvimento de produtos automotivos.


Projetista – NX Unigraphics


  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Concept;
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de atuação na área automotiva;
  • Sólido conhecimento em modelagem de peças plásticas, com foco em componentes externos;



O que oferecemos:


  • Vale Refeição Flexível;
  • Vale Transporte ou Vale Combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • TotalPass;
  • C4Life (plataforma de apoio psicológico);
  • Convênio Sesc;

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering, Computer Science , or related field preferred.
  • Fluent in English and at least one of: Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, or Thai .
  • 3–5+ years of experience in engineering support or industrial automation ; equivalent hands-on experience considered.
  • Willingness to work second or third shift (EST) to align with international time zones.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with R&D, Field Services, and Operations teams.


Why TARGAN?

Join a growing global company pioneering automation in animal health and agriculture . At TARGAN, you’ll collaborate with talented engineers across continents, support cutting-edge machinery, and make a direct impact on our customers’ success worldwide. Highly competitive base salary, bonus, benefits and stock options.


*Please note: final salary is dependent upon geographical location, experience and level*

title: Control Engineer
description:
Controls Engineer – Sustaining

Remote | Global Support Role | Full-Time

TARGAN


About the Role

TARGAN is transforming animal agriculture through advanced automation — and we’re looking for a Controls Engineer – Sustaining to help keep our systems running smoothly around the world.

This is a hands-on, global support role that bridges Field Services and R&D Controls Engineering . You’ll remotely monitor and troubleshoot our automated machinery at hatcheries across Brazil, Thailand, Italy, Spain , and North America — ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement of our control systems.


What You’ll Do

  • Remotely monitor TARGAN systems via cloud dashboards, PLC access, and on-machine interfaces .
  • Provide real-time technical support to field technicians via Teams and other communication tools .
  • Analyze hatchery performance data and participate in weekly global team meetings to share insights and best practices.
  • Serve as part of the escalation process when issues impact customer operations, coordinating with internal engineering teams.
  • Support ongoing refinement and optimization of control and electrical systems.


What You Bring

  • Proven ability to troubleshoot PLCs remotely and interpret electrical schematics.
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems , Ethernet networks , and industrial fieldbus protocols (EtherCAT, Modbus TCP, etc.).
  • Familiarity with industrial control languages (ladder logic, structured text, function block) and HMI systems .
  • Experience with tools such as AutoCAD Electrical or SolidWorks Electrical is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across technical and field teams.

title: Sales Account Manager
description:
Sales Account Manager

Location: Brazil (Remote)


About the role:

As an Sales Account Manager , you will play a pivotal role in achieving sales targets and driving the growth of BSI America’s product and service offerings related to ISO standards and certifications. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who thrives in a target-driven environment and enjoys developing long-term relationships with clients.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Drive Sales Growth : As a hunter in the sales field, develop and nurture relationships with existing clients while identifying and securing new business opportunities through prospecting and cold calling.
  • Consultative Selling : Engage with key decision-makers in small to midsize organizations to present and position BSI products and services, helping them meet ISO standards.
  • Pipeline Development : Identify and qualify new business leads, building a continuous sales pipeline to support long-term success.
  • Client Relationship Management : Foster strong relationships with clients, ensuring continuous business growth and repeat engagements.
  • Market Trend Identification : Stay ahead of industry trends, strategizing to capture new revenue generation opportunities.
  • Accurate Reporting : Provide timely and accurate sales reports, supporting business forecasting and strategy development.
  • Travel for Success : Travel to visit clients on a quarterly basis, building personal connections and furthering business opportunities.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Sales Experience : At least four years of experience in sales.
  • Industry Knowledge : Familiarity with the certification industry and/or ISO standards is a plus, though not essential.
  • Exceptional Communication Skills : Strong ability to negotiate, influence, and build relationships with both internal teams and external clients.
  • Collaboration Mindset : Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Tech-Savvy : Experience with CRM tools like SAP and Salesforce is an advantage.
  • Valid Driver's License : Travel to client sites is required on a quarterly basis.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of; 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial, and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.


Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance and regulatory services we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.


  • If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout out our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: "FINOPS/SAP Licensing Analyst #983107 "
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Gerenciar e otimizar custos de nuvem, garantindo eficiência financeira e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Assegurar conformidade com acordos de licenciamento SAP, otimizando o uso de licenças e evitando custos desnecessários.
  • Implementar e gerenciar dashboards e processos que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real sobre a eficiência dos recursos de nuvem e custos associados.
  • Colaborar com equipes de TI e áreas de negócio para promover uma cultura de colaboração interfuncional e responsabilidade financeira.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência em gestão de custos de nuvem e otimização de recursos (FinOps).
  • Conhecimento em SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Microsoft Power BI e Excel avançado.
  • Experiência com sistemas SAP ECC, S/4HANA e SAP HANA (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.
  • Fluência em inglês, tanto escrito quanto falado.
  • Criatividade, inovação e atenção à qualidade do trabalho.
  • Adaptabilidade a prazos apertados e mudanças de prioridade.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Gerenciar e otimizar custos de nuvem, garantindo eficiência financeira e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.
  • Assegurar conformidade com acordos de licenciamento SAP, otimizando o uso de licenças e evitando custos desnecessários.
  • Implementar e gerenciar dashboards e processos que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real sobre a eficiência dos recursos de nuvem e custos associados.
  • Colaborar com equipes de TI e áreas de negócio para promover uma cultura de colaboração interfuncional e responsabilidade financeira.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência em gestão de custos de nuvem e otimização de recursos (FinOps).
  • Conhecimento em SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Microsoft Power BI e Excel avançado.
  • Experiência com sistemas SAP ECC, S/4HANA e SAP HANA (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração.
  • Fluência em inglês, tanto escrito quanto falado.
  • Criatividade, inovação e atenção à qualidade do trabalho.
  • Adaptabilidade a prazos apertados e mudanças de prioridade.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: C++ Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for C++ Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed worldwide. We are looking for proactive people and team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Defining, developing, testing, analyzing, and maintaining real-time applications against defined interfaces.

- Find bottlenecks and defects in code and come up with remedies.

- Maintain code quality, design, and refactoring for optimal performance.

- Work with the BA, QA, operational, and cross-functional application teams to resolve data quality and performance concerns.


Requirements:


- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience in C++.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving.

- Hands-on experience with managing data loads and data quality is a plus.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!




Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Android embarcado



A Divisão de IBOPE Mídia está contratando Analista de P&D para desenvolver sistemas embarcados para trabalho em projetos de Audiência de TV.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de software embarcado para plataforma global de medição de audiência.
  • Manter tecnologias existentes, implementando novas soluções e/ou adaptando as existentes de acordo com as necessidades do produto.




O que buscamos?

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para ambiente Android, utilizando linguagem Java.
  • Formação: superior completo ou cursando último ano em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistema da Informação, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.



Conhecimento técnico fundamental:

  • Bom conhecimento de linguagem Java.
  • Conhecimento de Android embarcado, a partir da versão 9.



Conhecimento técnico desejável:

  • Noções de Node.JS.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de banco de dados SQL.
  • Conhecimento de UI/UX é considerado um plus.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, sob metodologia ágil.
  • Desejável ser um usuário intermediário/avançado de Linux.


Idioma: Fundamental Inglês avançado para uso diário.





O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

title: Gerente de vendas - Plataformas
description:
A Zoomlion Brasil, multinacional com forte atuação global nos segmentos de máquinas pesadas para Plataformas, está com processo seletivo aberto para a posição de Gerente de Vendas no Brasil.


Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para profissionais com sólida experiência no setor, perfil de liderança e visão comercial orientada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a equipe nacional de vendas, promovendo o desenvolvimento comercial dos profissionais;
  • Definir estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento global da empresa e às demandas do mercado brasileiro;
  • Gerenciar metas, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios de performance;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de mercado e novos canais de distribuição;
  • Atuar diretamente na negociação com grandes contas e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Representar a empresa em feiras, eventos e visitas institucionais, mantendo relacionamento próximo com clientes e stakeholders.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas);
  • Inglês avançado (interações frequentes com a matriz e equipes globais);

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Java Developer
description:
QAT Global, a US-based IT consulting firm with over 30 years of experience, is looking for a Java Developer to join our international team. We deliver world-class technology solutions with teams across the US, Costa Rica, and Brazil.


This is a full-time, remote position (CLT hire in Brazil only), offering the opportunity to collaborate directly with our US-based client and distributed development teams.


About the Role:


As a Java Developer , you will work on the design, development, and maintenance of Java-based applications that support key business functions. A strong command of Java 8 and hands-on experience with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) are essential for this role, as you will be deeply involved in log validation, performance optimization, and application stability.

This position is ideal for a professional who thrives in an agile, collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex technical challenges across multiple applications.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Java 8 applications using Spring Framework (Spring 4.1.3 and Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Lead and participate in application migration projects , with a focus on optimizing and validating logs in ELK .
  • Implement and fine-tune Elasticsearch indexing, querying, and data retrieval for high-performance applications.
  • Maintain and enhance front-end components using JSP, jQuery, and AngularJS .
  • Configure and deploy applications on Tomcat servers , ensuring reliability outside OpenShift environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to manage approximately 40 applications , maintaining stability and version consistency.
  • Utilize Azure DevOps templates for CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement and maintain automated smoke tests for proactive issue detection.


Required Qualifications:


  • Expert-level experience with Java 8 and Spring Frameworks (Spring 4.1.3, Spring Security 3.2.5).
  • Proven expertise working with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log management, validation, and performance analysis.
  • Strong understanding of Tomcat server configuration and deployments.
  • Experience developing scalable applications with Spring Boot 1.5.x .
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps and automated testing frameworks .
  • Solid knowledge of UI frameworks (JSP, jQuery, AngularJS).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, particularly in debugging, log validation, and application migration.
  • Strong English communication skills and ability to work effectively in distributed teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Information Technology , or related field (or equivalent experience).


Preferred Qualifications:


  • BS/MS in Systems Analysis and Development , Computer Science , or Computer Engineering .
  • Additional experience in client-facing roles or international projects.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Descrição da Empresa Outbank Cloud

Descrição do Cargo Estamos procurando um Desenvolvedor Full Stack para integrar nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve a criação e manutenção de aplicações web, tanto no front-end quanto back-end. As responsabilidades diárias incluem desenvolver e implementar novas funcionalidades, corrigir bugs e otimizar a performance de sistemas existentes. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e permite trabalho remoto.

Qualificações

  • Desenvolvimento Back-End: Necessário possuir experiência em desenvolvimento back-end, com foco na criação de APIs robustas e escaláveis.
  • Desenvolvimento Front-End: Conhecimento em desenvolvimento front-end, incluindo habilidades em HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
  • Desenvolvimento de Software: Experiência em desenvolvimento de software, com práticas de codificação limpa e testes automatizados.
  • Desenvolvimento Full-Stack: Experiência em desenvolvimento full-stack, sendo capaz de atuar tanto no front-end quanto no back-end.
  • Além das habilidades mencionadas, é desejável possuir conhecimento em frameworks modernos, como React ou Angular, e proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript ou Ruby.
  • Desenvolvedor Bubble ou FlutterFlow

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
Estamos contratando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno para atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas relacionados ao nosso produto de vale-transporte. A pessoa ideal deve ter boa capacidade técnica, proatividade e vontade de aprender e evoluir em um ambiente colaborativo.


Responsabilidades


· Desenvolver funcionalidades em sistemas legados e novos microsserviços.

· Participar de integrações via APIs REST e SOAP.

· Colaborar com o time na resolução de problemas técnicos e melhorias contínuas.

· Escrever testes unitários e seguir boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

· Participar das cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com ideias e soluções.


Requisitos Técnicos


· Java (8 ou superior), SpringBoot, Hibernate JPA.

· JSP, JSF, STRUTS (legado).

· Angular, Bootstrap, TypeScript, JavaScript.

· PL/SQL, Oracle.

· GIT, Maven ou Gradle.

· Conhecimento básico em containers e mensageria.

· Metodologias ágeis (Scrum).

· Testes com JUnit.


Diferenciais


· Experiência prévia com produtos de financeiros, mobilidade urbana ou benefícios corporativos (vale-transporte).

· Experiência com microsserviços e API Gateway (Sensedia).

· Conhecimento em MongoDB e Azure.

· Interesse em atuar com modernização de sistemas.

title: Sr. Cisco Meraki MX Security SME
description:
Job Title: Sr. Cisco Meraki MX Security SME

Work Location: Remote - LATAM

Duration - 3 Months


Job Overview:

This role is critical to the successful execution of Client's phased deployment of Cisco Meraki MX devices and associated security technologies across multiple customer locations. Lead the technical implementation of Phase One, which includes seven sites, and will directly contribute to the customer’s digital transformation and security posture. This is a cross-functional role requiring collaboration with IT, security, and cloud teams to ensure seamless integration and operational readiness.



Job Description:

  • Conduct discovery and documentation of existing IP schema across seven customer locations.
  • Design and implement new IP subnets for Office, Wireless, and Management networks.
  • Review DHCP server configuration, scope, and scope options for each location.
  • Identify network hosts that require manual static IP modifications or changes.
  • Deploy and configure Cisco Meraki MX devices, including switch port VLAN mapping.
  • Create standardized operational templates, profiles, and dashboards for Meraki environments.
  • Establish secure VPN tunnels and configure Cisco Secure Client for endpoint protection.
  • Cisco Secure Client Integration: Ensure the use of Cisco Secure Client for secure access.
  • Endpoint and End User Connections: Create and manage connections with endpoints and end users.
  • VPN Access: Ensure VPN access is available across all devices.
  • Cloud Integration: Integrate with Azure and AWS for cloud services.
  • Integrate Cisco Duo MFA to secure access to critical applications (e.g., Pension Pro).
  • Perform Active Directory integration for centralized user management.
  • Support cloud service integration with Azure and AWS.
  • Collaborate with internal and customer teams to ensure successful deployment and knowledge transfer.
  • Participate in testing, validation, and final review phases of the project.

Experience Requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise network deployment and configuration.
  • Proven experience with Cisco Meraki MX series, including dashboard configuration and VPN setup.
  • Hands-on experience with Cisco Duo MFA and Cisco Secure Client.
  • Familiarity with IP schema design, subnetting, and VLAN configuration.
  • Experience integrating cloud services (Azure, AWS) into enterprise networks.
  • Prior involvement in phased deployment projects across multiple physical locations is preferred.

Educational Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Cisco certifications (e.g., CCNA, Meraki CMNA) preferred.
  • Additional certifications in cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) or security (e.g., CISSP) are a plus.

title: Senior FullStack Developer (Java+React) [Portugal]
description:
This vacancy is for our Portuguese team and you will have to relocate to Portugal.


We’re launching a new partnership with a valued client in fintech, and we’re growing our team to support this exciting collaboration

Client is a financial sciences company, combining data analysis, invention, and rigorous inquiry to help solve the toughest challenges in investment management, insurance technology, securities, private equity, and venture capital.


Project Overview:

The platform is a portfolio analytics tool used by asset owners, asset managers, and advisors.

The platform applies the best expertise in research, data science, and technology to modernize the analytics experience for institutional investors, helping them embrace a quantitative approach to multi-asset portfolio risk and investment decision making.

The available tools help investors perform factor-based risk analysis to inform manager due diligence, investment evaluation, and portfolio construction.

The client's headquarters is in the USA

We are seeking an experienced, full-stack Software Engineer to help own the innovation, technical design, and development of the platform.

Technology Stack:

  • Cloud based, modern web application stack using Java, Typescript, React.js
  • Apollo GraphQL as an popular open-source ecosystem for building and managing GraphQL APIs
  • Service oriented architecture, infrastructure-as-code
  • Continuous development and deployment
  • Auto-scaling and robust search (Postgres, OpenSearch)
  • Cloud technologies (AWS)
  • Cloud monitoring (Datadog)
  • Test automation (Cypress)


Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience preferred building and delivering customer facing products
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline
  • 7+ years of Experience with Java development
  • 3+ years of Experience with modern front-end technologies: React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript**
  • Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, test automation, DevOps and cloud technologies (AWS preferred)
  • Prior experience with systems design, building enterprise SaaS solutions, experience with user research, and product analytics are a major plus
  • Strong communication skills , keen attention to detail, readiness to challenge assumptions and obsession with building quality software


Responsibilities:

  • Create, design, build and deploy SaaS product end to end with an agile approach, from conceptualization, through rigorous testing, and partnering with client´s multi-functional teams to ensure an outstanding in-product UX
  • Conduct front-end web development using React, TypeScript, CSS, and other technologies
  • Perform API design and development in Java, using cloud, microservices, and caching
  • Become a domain expert and trusted advisor in the full-stack software engineering field
  • Contribute to the continuous learning approach of the team by bringing in new insights, welcoming them from others, and generating even stronger outcomes as a result
  • Provide hands-on coding support and perform code reviews to ensure quality standards
  • Communicate clearly about progress, challenges, and technical decisions


Let us know if this challenge is for you!

title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe.    
Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:  

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.js , priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. 
  • Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB) , com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade.  
  • Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem , configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS.      
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :  transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos.      
  • Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD , testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração.  
  • Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.


O que nós estamos procurando;    

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata.      
  • Experiência solida (+5 anos):  em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.js, JavaScript e TypeScript.     
  • Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL , com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance.      
  • Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) , incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD , uso de Docker , Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.
  • Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas.  
  • Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).


O que oferecemos;       

  • VR/VT       
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)       
  • Gympass       
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico       
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!)       
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)      
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)       

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;       

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados       
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender       
  • Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar       
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!       

Junte-se a nós!

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce)
description:
We are looking for a Sr. Applications Developer (Salesforce) who will be responsible for developing complex business needs and providing technical solutions for our Salesforce ecosystem. This person should be flexible to adopt or learn new tools to map the growing business processes as the need arises. This role will report into IT Business Systems team. This role will help positively impact our commercial sales, marketing, agronomy, finance, supply chain, IT & other key business functions with smart, forward-looking solutions and operational efficiency.


Responsibilities:

  • Administer, design, develop & support Salesforce Platform (Sales, Service, Marketing/Pardot, Experience Cloud)
  • Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code.
  • Develop Apex (classes and triggers), experience building Custom User Interface, including Visualforce pages/Lightning pages, Aura Components and Lightning Web Components.
  • Design and develop sites using Experience Site Builder and customization of experience site interface.
  • Design and develop custom workflows, approval flows as fits the business needs and prepare solution design documents, data flow diagrams, test cases etc. as needed.
  • Adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write / maintain test classes for all custom development.
  • Work directly with business (Commercial Sales & Marketing, Agronomy) understanding the business requirements & provide timely and apt solutions.
  • Closely work with extended IT team developers to design, develop, test, implement & support system solutions primarily in Salesforce Platform.


Qualifications and Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on development & design experience with Salesforce Platform is a MUST
  • Experience implementing and developing in Apex, LWC/Aura/Visualforce is a MUST
  • General web development experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript is a MUST
  • Experience working with large data sets, Salesforce API’s and bulkification is a MUST
  • Excellent analytical and debugging skills is a MUST
  • Knowledge of IT SDLC and SOX methodologies is MUST
  • Experience with mobile publisher, Salesforce maps are a big plus
  • Experience with ERP, Datawarehouse, BI/Tableau tools are a big plus
  • Ability to work as part of IT team with clear verbal and written communication
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, and Information Systems is preferred

title: Desenvolvedor de Back-end (Python)
description:
Sobre nós:

A Eviden é líder em tecnologia de última geração em transformação digital sustentável, confiável e orientada por dados. Com um forte portfólio de tecnologias patenteadas e posições de liderança mundial em computação avançada, segurança, IA, nuvem e plataformas digitais, ela fornece profunda expertise para todos os setores em mais de 47 países. Reunindo 41.000 talentos de classe mundial, a Eviden expande as possibilidades de dados e tecnologia em todo o continuum digital, agora e para as gerações futuras. A Eviden é uma empresa do Grupo Atos com uma receita anual de mais de € 5 bilhões.



*** Desenvolvedor Back-end (Python) ***


Vaga Home Office


Perfil Pleno/sênior



Realizar atividades de back-end em um projeto de Visão Computacional e Inteligência Artificial.



1) Responsabilidades

• Projetar, desenvolver e manter serviços escaláveis e confiáveis em Python (Django, FastAPI ou Flask).

• Criar e manter APIs RESTful que integrem sistemas internos e externos.

• Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD para automação de testes, builds e deploys.

• Trabalhar com Kubernetes para implantar e escalar aplicações em ambientes de produção.

• Implementar boas práticas de monitoramento, log e alertas (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).

• Colaborar com o time de DevOps em infraestrutura como código (IaC) usando ferramentas como Terraform ou Helm.

• Otimizar desempenho, confiabilidade e segurança dos sistemas.

• Participar de code reviews, discussões de arquitetura e planejamento técnico.



2) Requisitos

• 3+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento back-end com Python;

• Domínio de frameworks Python como Django, FastAPI ou Flask;

• Experiência prática com Docker;

• Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins);

• Entendimento de arquitetura de microsserviços e princípios de design de APIs REST;

• Experiência com bancos de dados SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (Redis, MongoDB);

• Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade;

• Foco em código limpo, testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia;

• Graduação completa em Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins;

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Representante executivo de vendas
description:
Descrição da Empresa Representante da Brasilux Tintas Ltda., nos segmentos automotivo, imobiliário, industrial (linha líquida ou pó) e moveleiro no estado do Espírito Santo.

Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Representante Executivo de Vendas para integrar a equipe da C.T.L. Representações LTDA., representante da Brasilux Tintas. Este cargo envolve atividades diárias como prospecção de novos clientes, planejamento e execução de estratégias de vendas, e manutenção do relacionamento com clientes existentes. Adicionalmente, o profissional será responsável por atingir metas de vendas, apresentar soluções técnicas aos clientes e manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos da empresa. Este é um cargo remoto, permitindo flexibilidade de localização.

Qualificações


  • Prospecção e Rede de Contatos: Necessário possuir experiência em prospecção de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de uma rede de contatos forte e relevante dentro do setor.
  • Estratégias de Vendas: Habilidades em planejar e implementar estratégias de vendas eficientes e eficazes para atingir e superar metas estabelecidas.
  • Relacionamento com Clientes: Experiência em manter e desenvolver relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes, garantindo sua satisfação e fidelidade.
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Desejável conhecimento sobre tintas e revestimentos.
